checks: 36 common validation months, no missing or duplicate model forecasts
Daily adjustment has rank 16 in every fold; no current unlabelled months used for fitting
Monthly training counts 44–79; all labels released by their forecast origins
Development weekday, festival, adjustment and validation-error plots visually reviewed
Future daily and unreleased-label perturbations leave historical predictions unchanged
selection_reason: Penalty 100 minimizes the prespecified validation MAE. Penalty 10 has lower RMSE; no criterion switch.
findings: Pandemic contraction and 2021 base effects dominate validation errors. Delayed target lags can produce large later overshoots. Daily adjustment removes the weekday profile while retaining trend and disruption.
decisions: Retain all four planned models, the primary specification, and every prespecified sensitivity. Do not add models or tune on test.
protocol: report.ipynb methods section and results/methods_protocol.json; circular moving-block paired MAE intervals, three months, 2000 draws, fixed seed.
